summary: If you read the study the mean score fell below two, but a mean isn't most. I didn't see a mode reported but based on the graph this just looks like a instance of mixing up mode and mean. Wonder what results would be if only "top" downloads taken.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: If you read the study the mean score fell below two, but a mean isn't most. I didn't see a mode reported but based on the graph this just looks like a instance of mixing up mode and mean. Wonder what results would be if only "top" downloads taken.
